rules.statement: An oral account stated does not create a new cause of action that can evade the statute of limitations if it is merely an acknowledgment or promise by words only.
rules.supporting_quote: "Now, this new contract is not to be proved by an 'acknowledgment or promise by words only.' That is admitted, it cannot be denied; but it is said that the 'acknowledgment or promise' in the Ordinance refers to cases where there is only one side of the account."
